== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Gold 1]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed Limited card and the printed Unlimited card. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Limited and Unlimited: the printed Limited card (600 dpi scan Premiere-L-gold1-hires.webp) has no pilot sentence; [[Gold 1 (Unlimited)]] (April 1996) adds it (Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2, p. 35). The Decipher.com image Premiere-L-gold1-decipher-archive.gif has a black border but the Unlimited text.
